name: ogbg-ppa
description: A protein graph classification dataset containing about 158k protein graphs. Distinct from ogbl-ppa, the link-prediction benchmark. Related OGB graph-property dataset ogbg-code2 is a code graph benchmark. This record is metadata-only; no data is vendored.
citation: Hu, W., Fey, M., Zitnik, M., Dong, Y., Ren, H., Liu, B., Catasta, M., & Leskovec, J. (2020). Open Graph Benchmark: Datasets for Machine Learning on Graphs. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 33, 22118–22133. https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.00687 (ogbg-ppa)
